rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid NMSB 7310:2015 certificate, valid until 30 June 2027.
Visakoivu Oy holds Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, which satisfies the minimum requirement of class S2.

Visakoivu Oy's framework agreement with Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (kiinteistonhoito and LVI maintenance across five health centres) was valued at EUR 1,650,000, well above the required reference value.

Unresolved faults are escalated through a defined chain from the responsible site technician to the discipline lead and, where a fault remains open beyond its target resolution time, to Visakoivu Oy's account manager for the framework agreement, who reports the escalation to the wellbeing services county.
A method statement describing sequencing, access arrangements and safety measures for installation works is provided for each call-off order before work begins on site.

Elevator servicing is arranged through an accredited elevator-maintenance subcontractor under Visakoivu Oy's subcontractor management framework, with Visakoivu Oy remaining responsible for ensuring the work meets applicable elevator safety regulations and for reporting the results to the wellbeing services county.
Visakoivu Oy maintains stock of common spare and wear parts and sources non-stocked parts through established supplier relationships, with delivery times confirmed per item at the time of order.

Fire-protection systems are serviced as part of Visakoivu Oy's building-services maintenance, with statutory inspection and certification testing carried out by accredited fire-safety subcontractors where specialist certification is required, and records kept and reported to the wellbeing services county.

Visakoivu Oy provides round-the-clock on-call duty within Finland covering the wellbeing services county's properties through its LVI, sahko and kiinteistonhoito teams, with urgent faults affecting health-service operation given priority response ahead of routine call-offs.

On handover, Visakoivu Oy will deliver an up-to-date asset register and supporting documentation for the properties covered by the framework agreement, in a format agreed with the wellbeing services county, and will keep the register current for the duration of the agreement.

Visakoivu Oy operates an occupational safety plan under its NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety system, covering site risk assessment, permit-to-work procedures and incident reporting for all work carried out under this framework agreement.
Visakoivu Oy proposes an annual price adjustment linked to a nationally published cost index for building maintenance services, applied once per contract year.
Visakoivu Oy accepts a limitation of liability clause consistent with standard framework agreement terms, to be finalised in the contract documents with the wellbeing services county.
Visakoivu Oy accepts the five-year initial contract period and is prepared to discuss any extension exercised at the wellbeing services county's discretion on the same terms as the initial period.
Visakoivu Oy accepts termination conditions consistent with standard framework agreement terms, to be finalised in the contract documents with the wellbeing services county.

This notice states two different warranty periods for installed equipment: Section 5.5 of the body specifies 24 months from acceptance, while Liite B clause 1.2 specifies 12 months from delivery. Visakoivu Oy flags this discrepancy for clarification and, pending confirmation from the wellbeing services county, will honour the longer 24-month-from-acceptance period stated in the body.
CVs of the key personnel proposed for this framework agreement, covering the relevant LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito disciplines, are enclosed with this tender.
An insurance certificate confirming Visakoivu Oy's liability insurance cover of EUR 2,000,000 is enclosed with this tender.
All prices in this tender are quoted excluding VAT, in euro.
Pricing is structured on a per-property basis, consistent with the framework agreement's call-off structure, with a per-square-metre reference rate also provided where requested.
Prices in this tender are stated as euro per square metre per year, not euro per month, as required.

This notice states two different warranty periods for installed equipment: Section 5.5 of the body specifies 24 months from acceptance, while Liite B clause 1.2 specifies 12 months from delivery. Visakoivu Oy flags this discrepancy for clarification and, pending confirmation from the wellbeing services county, will honour the longer 24-month-from-acceptance period stated in the body.

Periodic statutory inspections of electrical installations are carried out by personnel operating under Visakoivu Oy's Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, with inspection records kept and made available to the wellbeing services county.

Condition-monitoring data is collected and evaluated by Visakoivu Oy's rakennusautomaatio team (18 specialists), who maintain building automation and monitoring systems across client properties as part of routine and preventive maintenance.

Visakoivu Oy's rakennusautomaatio team implements and maintains building automation systems using open protocols, including BACnet and Modbus, ensuring compatibility with the wellbeing services county's existing building automation infrastructure.
Visakoivu Oy accepts a contractual penalty tied to shortfalls against the agreed service level, with the mechanism and rate to be finalised in the framework agreement's contract documents.

This notice states two different warranty periods for installed equipment: this annex clause specifies 12 months from delivery, while Section 5.5 of the body specifies 24 months from acceptance. Visakoivu Oy flags this discrepancy for clarification and, pending confirmation from the wellbeing services county, will honour the longer 24-month-from-acceptance period stated in the body.
A current certificate of pension insurance payments for Visakoivu Oy is enclosed with this tender.
The confidentiality undertaking referenced in this clause is signed by Visakoivu Oy's authorised representative and returned with this tender.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this tender for the technical building systems maintenance and installation framework agreement, reference PKHYVA-2026-0087. We have read the notice and both annexes in full and have addressed every requirement in the sections that follow, including one discrepancy we noticed between the body and an annex, flagged at clause 5.5.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, founded in 1994, with around 180 employees working across LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito. The company holds NMSB 7310, NMSB 74210 and NMSB 75310 certification, LUSA-patevyys and Sahkourakointioikeudet, and has delivered several framework agreements for public health and municipal property portfolios.
